scripts.preflight: npm run preflight:go && npm run preflight:build && npm run preflight:codeql && npm run preflight:secrets
scripts.preflight:go: go vet ./... && go test -timeout 600s ./... && go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@v2.28.0 -conf .gosec.json -quiet -exclude-dir=ui/node_modules ./...
scripts.preflight:secrets: gitleaks detect --source . --no-git --no-banner 2>&1 && echo 'secrets: OK' || echo 'gitleaks: SKIP (not installed)'
